propositions: Below-seam ambient config and credential reads in mcp_server.py and _mcp_auth.py must be routed through approved composition-root seam resolvers instead of reading env/config directly.
Three new owned composition-root resolvers (mcp_gate, compose_config, read_secret_env) must be added to config.py to enable seam-compliant config/secret resolution at the boundary.
MCP consumers must be refactored to receive composed config and resolved secret values from the new config.py resolvers instead of calling load_config() or os.environ.get below the seam.
LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS entries for the three affected MCP files must be removed from scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.py, and check_config_ownership.py must report zero findings for those paths.
Per-request resolution semantics must be preserved with no behavioral delta; subsystem test suites must pass unmodified after the cutover.
